examples.en: She was completely taken aback by his anger.
examples.zh: 她被他的怒气彻底惊住了。

examples.en: The storm showed no signs of abating.
examples.zh: 暴风雨没有减弱的迹象。

examples.en: He abdicated in favour of his son.
examples.zh: 他退位让自己的儿子继位。

examples.en: Economists dismissed last month's jump in inflation as an aberration.
examples.zh: 经济学家认为上个月通胀的猛增只是异常现象。

examples.en: He was abetted in the deception by his wife.
examples.zh: 他的妻子协助他实施了这场欺骗。

examples.en: He is an artist with an abiding concern for humanity.
examples.zh: 他是一位始终关怀人类的艺术家。

examples.en: The whole building was soon ablaze.
examples.zh: 整栋建筑很快便熊熊燃烧起来。

examples.en: Every window was ablaze with light.
examples.zh: 每扇窗户都灯火通明。

examples.en: He turned to her, his eyes ablaze with anger.
examples.zh: 他转向她，双眼燃烧着怒火。

meanings: 废除，彻底取消（制度、法律、惯例等）

examples.en: This tax should be abolished.
examples.zh: 这项税应该废除。

examples.en: Stories about his travels abound.
examples.zh: 关于他旅行的故事很多。

meanings: 了解最新情况的（常接 of）

examples.en: I like to keep abreast of current affairs.
examples.zh: 我喜欢随时了解时事。

meanings: 正式废除，撤销（法律、协议等）

examples.en: The rule has been abrogated by mutual consent.
examples.zh: 双方同意废除了这条规则。

examples.en: The abrupt change of subject disconcerted her.
examples.zh: 话题的突然变化使她不知所措。

examples.en: She was very abrupt with me in our meeting.
examples.zh: 会面时，她对我十分生硬无礼。

examples.en: The interview ended abruptly.
examples.zh: 访谈突然结束了。

meanings: 引人入胜的，令人全神贯注的

examples.en: Fishing can be a totally absorbing hobby.
examples.zh: 钓鱼可以是一种使人全神贯注的爱好。

meanings: 深奥难解的，难以理解的

examples.en: That uniform makes the guards look absurd.
examples.zh: 那套制服让卫兵看起来很可笑。

examples.en: Ahead of them was a gaping abyss.
examples.zh: 他们前方是一个张着大口的深渊。

examples.en: He acceded to demands for his resignation.
examples.zh: 他同意了要求他辞职的请求。

examples.en: Queen Victoria acceded to the throne in 1837.
examples.zh: 维多利亚女王于1837年即位。

examples.en: Her short hair accentuated her huge eyes.
examples.zh: 她的短发突出了她那双大眼睛。

examples.en: The work was acclaimed as a masterpiece.
examples.zh: 这部作品被誉为杰作。

meanings: 上前搭话，冒失地或咄咄逼人地与人攀谈

examples.en: She was accosted in the street by a complete stranger.
examples.zh: 一个完全陌生的人在街上贸然上前与她搭话。

meanings: 须作出解释或承担后果的义务

examples.en: She accused him of lying.
examples.zh: 她指责他说谎。

examples.en: He's just a business acquaintance.
examples.zh: 他只是一个生意上的熟人。

examples.en: He hoped their acquaintance would develop further.
examples.zh: 他希望两人的交情能进一步发展。

examples.en: I had little acquaintance with modern poetry.
examples.zh: 我对现代诗歌了解很少。

examples.en: His latest acquisition is a racehorse.
examples.zh: 他最近购得的东西是一匹赛马。

meanings: 渴望占有的，贪求财物的

examples.en: It is an acquisitive company looking for ways to expand.
examples.zh: 这是一家渴望扩张、寻求扩张途径的公司。

meanings: 为推动社会或政治目标而采取的积极行动

examples.en: Eva was adamant that she would not come.
examples.zh: 伊娃坚决表示她不会来。

meanings: 传说中坚不可摧的石头或极硬物

examples.en: Clean the surface first, or the paint will not adhere.
examples.zh: 先清洁表面，否则油漆附着不上去。

examples.en: The planes landed on adjacent runways.
examples.zh: 飞机降落在相邻的跑道上。

examples.en: A special subcommittee adjudicates on planning applications.
examples.zh: 一个专门小组委员会负责裁决规划申请。

examples.en: Who is adjudicating at this year's contest?
examples.zh: 谁担任今年比赛的裁判？

meanings: 值得钦佩的，令人赞赏的

examples.en: Her dedication to her work was admirable.
examples.zh: 她对工作的投入令人钦佩。

examples.en: Stop acting like an adolescent!
examples.zh: 别再像个青春期少年那样行事了！

examples.en: Gold rings adorned his fingers.
examples.zh: 金戒指装饰着他的手指。

examples.en: The water supply had been adulterated with chemicals from the soil.
examples.zh: 供水已经被土壤中的化学物质污染了。

examples.en: This drug is known to have adverse side effects.
examples.zh: 已知这种药有不良副作用。

examples.en: The works of art are judged on purely aesthetic grounds.
examples.zh: 这些艺术品纯粹根据审美标准来评判。

meanings: 和蔼可亲的，友善易交谈的

examples.en: He greeted everyone in the same relaxed and affable manner.
examples.zh: 他以同样轻松和蔼的态度迎接每一个人。

examples.en: Humans have a special affinity for dolphins.
examples.zh: 人类对海豚有一种特殊的喜爱。

examples.en: There is a close affinity between Italian and Spanish.
examples.zh: 意大利语和西班牙语非常相似。

examples.en: His speech was an affront to many in the local community.
examples.zh: 他的讲话公然冒犯了当地社区的许多人。

examples.en: These small particles agglomerate together to form larger clusters.
examples.zh: 这些小颗粒聚集在一起，形成更大的团簇。

examples.en: Pollution can aggravate asthma.
examples.zh: 污染可能加重哮喘。

examples.en: Erica looked at him aghast.
examples.zh: 埃里卡惊骇地看着他。

examples.en: As a player, she combines strength and agility.
examples.zh: 作为一名运动员，她兼具力量与敏捷。

examples.en: I spent days agonizing over whether to take the job or not.
examples.zh: 我为是否接受那份工作苦苦思索了好几天。

examples.en: Jack collapsed in agony on the floor.
examples.zh: 杰克痛苦地倒在地板上。

examples.en: It was agony not knowing where the children were.
examples.zh: 不知道孩子们在哪里，令人痛苦万分。

meanings: 作物生产与土壤管理学

examples.en: He looked after his ailing father.
examples.zh: 他照顾生病的父亲。

examples.en: I got all the usual childhood ailments.
examples.zh: 儿童常见的小病我都得过。

examples.en: He stood outside, breathing the cold night air.
examples.zh: 他站在外面，呼吸着寒冷的夜间空气。

examples.en: There was an air of complete confidence about her.
examples.zh: 房间透着奢华的气息。

examples.en: Do not leave your seat until the plane is airborne.
examples.zh: 飞机升空前请不要离开座位。

examples.en: This game is closely akin to hockey.
examples.zh: 这项运动与曲棍球非常相似。

examples.en: The danger is not as great as the alarmists are saying.
examples.zh: 危险并不像那些危言耸听者所说的那么大。

examples.en: He finally agreed, albeit reluctantly, to help us.
examples.zh: 他最终同意帮助我们，尽管有些不情愿。

meanings: 外国的，陌生的，不相容的

examples.en: They tried to treat all their children alike.
examples.zh: 他们尽力平等对待所有孩子。

examples.en: It is alleged that he mistreated the prisoners.
examples.zh: 据称他虐待了囚犯。

examples.en: He affirmed his allegiance to the president.
examples.zh: 他重申了对总统的忠诚。

examples.en: The Social Democrats are now in alliance with the Greens.
examples.zh: 社会民主党现在与绿党结盟。

examples.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.
examples.zh: 黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

meanings: 掺杂而减损纯度或品质

examples.en: The country has lost its allure as a destination for foreign investment.
examples.zh: 这个国家作为外国投资目的地已失去了吸引力。

examples.en: Portugal is a traditional ally of England.
examples.zh: 葡萄牙是英格兰的传统盟友。

examples.en: His sister was his ally against their grandparents.
examples.zh: 面对祖父母时，他的姐姐站在他这一边。

meanings: 可供选择的事物，替代方案

examples.en: There is a vegetarian alternative on the menu every day.
examples.zh: 菜单上每天都有素食可供选择。

examples.en: Politicians are not necessarily motivated by pure altruism.
examples.zh: 政治人物的动机未必是纯粹的利他主义。

examples.en: The film script is an amalgam of all three books.
examples.zh: 这部电影的剧本融合了那三本书的内容。

examples.en: He amassed a fortune from silver mining.
examples.zh: 他通过开采银矿积累了一笔财富。

examples.en: The performance sounded very amateur, I’m afraid.
examples.zh: 恐怕这场演出听起来很不专业。

examples.en: New rules on amateurism allow payment for promotional work.
examples.zh: 关于业余身份的新规定允许推广活动获得报酬。

meanings: 同时存在相反的态度或感情

examples.en: The film captures the common feeling of ambivalence about growing up and leaving home.
examples.zh: 电影捕捉到了人们对长大和离家普遍怀有的矛盾心情。

examples.en: Steps have been taken to ameliorate the situation.
examples.zh: 已经采取措施改善局面。

examples.en: He seemed most amenable to my idea.
examples.zh: 他似乎非常愿意接受我的想法。

meanings: 和蔼可亲的，友善随和的

examples.en: Her parents seemed very amiable.
examples.zh: 她的父母似乎很和蔼。

examples.en: An amicable settlement was reached.
examples.zh: 双方达成了友好解决方案。

examples.en: She sensed something was amiss and called the police.
examples.zh: 她觉察到情况不对，便报了警。

examples.en: They issued live ammunition to the troops.
examples.zh: 他们向部队发放了实弹。

examples.en: The letter gave her all the ammunition she needed.
examples.zh: 这封信给了她所需的全部反击材料。

meanings: 尤指秘密或不正当的恋情

examples.en: He enjoyed talking about his past amours.
examples.zh: 他喜欢谈论自己过去的恋情。

examples.en: There was ample time to get to the airport.
examples.zh: 去机场的时间很充裕。

examples.en: You may need to amplify this point.
examples.zh: 你可能需要进一步阐述这一点。

examples.en: The costumes were anachronistic for a Victorian play.
examples.zh: 对于一部维多利亚时代题材的戏剧来说，这些服装不合时代。

meanings: 毛发生长周期的生长期

examples.en: The two processes are not analogous.
examples.zh: 这两个过程并不相似。

examples.en: There are no analogies with any previous legal cases.
examples.zh: 与以往任何法律案件都没有相似之处。

examples.en: She has a clear, analytical mind.
examples.zh: 她思路清晰，善于分析。

meanings: 令人厌恶或强烈排斥的人或事

examples.en: We raised the anchor and set sail.
examples.zh: 我们起锚扬帆出发了。

examples.en: She was questioned by an NBC anchor about her trip.
examples.zh: 一位NBC新闻主播就她的旅行采访了她。

examples.en: The book is a rich store of anecdote.
examples.zh: 这本书汇集了大量轶事。

examples.en: He groaned in anguish.
examples.zh: 他痛苦地呻吟着。

examples.en: A smile suddenly animated her face.
examples.zh: 一个微笑突然使她的脸生动起来。

examples.en: The much-loved characters have been animated in this new feature film.
examples.zh: 这些深受喜爱的人物在这部新故事片中被制作成了动画。

meanings: 使互补核酸链退火配对

examples.en: The drawings were all clearly annotated.
examples.zh: 这些图画都标注得很清楚。

examples.en: Amid renewed protests, the regime annulled the elections.
examples.zh: 抗议再次爆发后，该政权宣布选举无效。

examples.en: There are areas of anomaly in the report.
examples.zh: 报告中有一些异常之处。

examples.en: He has always been the prime minister’s most formidable antagonist in Parliament.
examples.zh: 他一直是首相在议会中最难对付的对手。

examples.en: The interview made her antagonistic towards journalists.
examples.zh: 那次采访使她对记者产生了敌意。

examples.en: This year tournament organizers have upped the ante by offering record prize money for the top two teams.
examples.zh: 今年赛事组织者为前两名队伍提供创纪录的奖金，提高了竞争的筹码。

meanings: 战前的，尤指美国南北战争前的

examples.en: In ‘He grabbed the ball and threw it in the air’, ‘ball’ is the antecedent of ‘it’.
examples.zh: 在“He grabbed the ball and threw it in the air”中，“ball”是“it”的先行词。

examples.en: The crypt antedates the rest of the building by several centuries.
examples.zh: 这座地下室比建筑的其余部分早建了几个世纪。

meanings: 文学、艺术或音乐作品集

examples.en: We have put together an anthology of children’s poetry.
examples.zh: 我们编了一部儿童诗选集。

meanings: 把人的特征赋予非人事物的理解方式

examples.en: We don't anticipate any major problems.
examples.zh: 我们预计不会有任何重大问题。

examples.en: We eagerly anticipated the day we would leave school.
examples.zh: 我们热切期待着离校的那一天。

meanings: 滑稽、荒唐或引人注意的动作、行为

examples.en: The bank staff got up to all sorts of antics to raise money for charity.
examples.zh: 银行员工做了各种滑稽的事情，为慈善事业筹款。

examples.en: His professional judgement was coloured by his personal antipathies.
examples.zh: 他在职业上的判断受到个人好恶的影响。

examples.en: The antiquated heating system barely heats the larger rooms.
examples.zh: 这套陈旧的供暖系统几乎无法使大房间暖和起来。

examples.en: The statue was brought to Rome in antiquity.
examples.zh: 这座雕像在古代被带到了罗马。

examples.en: A number of the monuments are of considerable antiquity.
examples.zh: 其中不少古迹年代相当久远。

examples.en: The illness made her apathetic and unwilling to meet people.
examples.zh: 疾病使她变得冷漠，不愿见人。

examples.en: At 37, she'd reached the apex of her career.
examples.zh: 37岁时，她已达到事业的顶峰。

meanings: 简练的道理或原则陈述

examples.en: She concealed the problem with remarkable aplomb.
examples.zh: 她十分镇定地掩饰了这个问题。

examples.en: Most of the stories about him are apocryphal.
examples.zh: 关于他的大多数故事可能都是杜撰的。

examples.en: He became known as the chief apologist for hardline government policies.
examples.zh: 他作为政府强硬政策的主要辩护者而出名。

examples.en: Her remarks are extremely apposite to the present discussion.
examples.zh: 她的言论与当前的讨论极为切合。

examples.en: She stepped back to appraise her workmanship.
examples.zh: 她后退一步，审视自己的手艺。

examples.en: The police apprehended an armed suspect near the scene of the crime.
examples.zh: 警方在犯罪现场附近抓获了一名持械嫌疑人。

examples.en: He was slow to apprehend danger.
examples.zh: 他迟迟没有意识到危险。

examples.en: The King received the official approbation of the church.
examples.zh: 国王得到了教会的正式认可。

examples.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal party.
examples.zh: 牛仔裤不适合正式聚会。

examples.en: That question seemed quite apt in the circumstances.
examples.zh: 在当时的情况下，那个问题似乎很恰当。

examples.en: Babies are apt to put objects into their mouths.
examples.zh: 婴儿往往会把东西放进嘴里。

meanings: 任意的，缺乏系统依据的

examples.en: The choice of players for the team seemed completely arbitrary.
examples.zh: 为球队挑选队员似乎完全没有依据。

meanings: 古老的、过时的、现已少用的

examples.en: The system is archaic and unfair and needs changing.
examples.zh: 这种制度陈旧且不公平，需要改变。

examples.en: The Beatles were the archetypal pop group.
examples.zh: 披头士是典型的流行乐队。

examples.en: She is the archetype of an American movie star.
examples.zh: 她是典型的美国电影明星。

examples.en: The work was arduous.
examples.zh: 这项工作很费力。

examples.en: He is arguably the best actor of his generation.
examples.zh: 可以说他是他那一代最优秀的演员。

examples.en: Her strange behaviour aroused our suspicions.
examples.zh: 她奇怪的举止引起了我们的怀疑。

examples.en: He was a rude, arrogant young man.
examples.zh: 他是个粗鲁傲慢的年轻人。

examples.en: He was artful and cunning, and I didn’t really trust him.
examples.zh: 他机巧狡猾，我并不怎么信任他。

examples.en: She struggled to articulate her thoughts.
examples.zh: 她努力想把自己的想法表达清楚。

meanings: 人为因素造成的假象或图像伪影

examples.en: He played the piece with effortless artistry.
examples.zh: 他以轻松自如的高超技艺演奏了这首曲子。

examples.en: The cruise included several days ashore.
examples.zh: 这次邮轮旅行包括在岸上停留几天。

examples.en: She pulled the curtain aside.
examples.zh: 她把窗帘拉到一边。

examples.en: There was a touch of asperity in his tone.
examples.zh: 他的语气里有几分严厉。

examples.en: He nodded (his) assent.
examples.zh: 他点头表示同意。

examples.en: She continued to assert that she was innocent.
examples.zh: 她继续坚称自己无罪。

examples.en: It's difficult to assess the effects of these changes.
examples.zh: 很难评估这些变化的影响。

examples.en: She was assiduous in her duties.
examples.zh: 她尽职尽责，十分勤勉。

examples.en: His reply did little to assuage my suspicions.
examples.zh: 他的答复几乎没有缓解我的疑虑。

examples.en: The performance was an astounding success.
examples.zh: 演出取得了惊人的成功。

examples.en: Use an astringent lotion if you have oily skin.
examples.zh: 如果你的皮肤油腻，请使用收敛性化妆水。

examples.en: Astronomers continue to discover new stars.
examples.zh: 天文学家不断发现新的恒星。

examples.en: The figures are astronomical.
examples.zh: 这些数字大得惊人。

examples.en: It was an astute move to sell the shares then.
examples.zh: 当时卖掉那些股票是个精明的举动。

examples.en: The cultural life of the country will sink into atrophy unless more writers and artists emerge.
examples.zh: 除非出现更多作家和艺术家，否则这个国家的文化生活将逐渐衰退。

meanings: 因疾病或不用而逐渐衰弱

examples.en: The cheetah can attain speeds of up to 97 kph.
examples.zh: 猎豹的速度可以达到每小时97公里。

examples.en: The drug attenuates the effects of the virus.
examples.zh: 这种药减弱了病毒的影响。

meanings: 使变薄或变细（attenuate 的第三人称单数）

examples.en: He wrote magazine articles in order to augment his income.
examples.zh: 他为杂志写文章以增加收入。

examples.en: With such a host of new features and augmentations, the new version of the game is a must-buy.
examples.zh: 这款游戏的新版本增加了大量新功能和改进内容，不容错过。

examples.en: He had dared to challenge the views of an august body of imperial historians.
examples.zh: 他竟敢挑战一群备受敬畏的帝国史学家的观点。

examples.en: It was an auspicious date for a wedding.
examples.zh: 那是个适合结婚的吉日。

examples.en: My father was a distant, austere man.
examples.zh: 我父亲是个疏远而严肃的人。

examples.en: Their clothes were always austere.
examples.zh: 他们的衣着总是很朴素。

examples.en: He governed as an autocrat.
examples.zh: 他以独裁者的方式统治。

examples.en: The theatre shows a lot of avant-garde work.
examples.zh: 这家剧院上演很多前卫作品。

examples.en: She averred that she had never seen the man before.
examples.zh: 她坚称自己以前从未见过那个男人。

examples.en: He had an aversion to getting up early.
examples.zh: 他讨厌早起。

examples.en: A disaster was narrowly averted.
examples.zh: 一场灾难被险险避免了。

examples.en: She averted her eyes from the terrible scene in front of her.
examples.zh: 她把目光从眼前可怕的场景上移开。

examples.en: He was avid for more information.
examples.zh: 他渴望获得更多信息。

meanings: 本职以外的副业或消遣

examples.en: An aide avowed that the president had known nothing of the deals.
examples.zh: 一位助手公开声称，总统对那些交易一无所知。

examples.en: The river had burst its banks and the road was awash.
examples.zh: 河水决堤，道路被淹没了。

examples.en: The city is awash with drugs.
examples.zh: 这座城市毒品泛滥。

examples.en: He speaks of her with awe.
examples.zh: 他谈起她时满怀敬畏。

examples.en: She rushed out, her hair awry.
examples.zh: 她冲了出去，头发凌乱。

examples.en: All my plans for the party had gone awry.
examples.zh: 我为聚会做的所有计划都出了岔子。

examples.en: Unfortunately the plan backfired.
examples.zh: 不幸的是，这个计划适得其反。

examples.en: In a backhanded compliment she said he looked very good for his age.
examples.zh: 她表面夸赞实则挖苦地说，以他的年龄而言，他看起来很不错。

examples.en: The region became more and more of an economic backwater.
examples.zh: 这个地区在经济上变得越来越闭塞落后。

examples.en: His behaviour baffles me.
examples.zh: 他的行为令我困惑。

meanings: 轻巧的文学或音乐小品

examples.en: It cost a mere bagatelle.
examples.zh: 它只花了一点点钱。

examples.en: She was released on £2 000 bail.
examples.zh: 她交了2000英镑保释金后被释放。

examples.en: Many parents may balk at the idea of paying $100 for a pair of shoes.
examples.zh: 许多家长可能不愿意花100美元买一双鞋。

examples.en: She murmured some banal phrases of encouragement.
examples.zh: 她低声说了几句陈腐的鼓励话。

examples.en: He pleaded with the Queen not to banish him.
examples.zh: 他恳求女王不要放逐他。

examples.en: He was determined to banish all feelings of guilt.
examples.zh: 他决心消除一切内疚感。

examples.en: He enjoyed exchanging banter with the customers.
examples.zh: 他喜欢和顾客互相打趣。

meanings: 历史上被称作异族或未开化者的人

examples.en: The barbarity of the old regime was eventually exposed.
examples.zh: 旧政权的残暴终于被揭露了。

examples.en: The bark peels off in summer.
examples.zh: 树皮在夏天脱落。

examples.en: The dog gave a loud bark.
examples.zh: 狗大声叫了一声。

meanings: 农场中存放收成或圈养牲畜的建筑

examples.en: Barring accidents, we should arrive on time.
examples.zh: 若无意外，我们应该能准时到达。

examples.en: The rumours were completely baseless.
examples.zh: 那些谣言完全没有根据。

examples.en: She got it at the church bazaar.
examples.zh: 她是在教堂的义卖会上得到它的。

examples.en: It was not very becoming behaviour for a teacher.
examples.zh: 那样的举止对教师来说很不得体。

examples.en: Honesty is the bedrock of any healthy relationship.
examples.zh: 诚实是任何健康关系的基础。

examples.en: Violence begets violence.
examples.zh: 暴力滋生暴力。

examples.en: Isaac begat Jacob.
examples.zh: 以撒生雅各。

examples.en: I don't begrudge her being so successful.
examples.zh: 我并不嫉妒她如此成功。

examples.en: They begrudge paying so much money for a second-rate service.
examples.zh: 他们不情愿为二流的服务付这么多钱。

meanings: 规模或力量极大的事物、组织

examples.en: She works in a seventy-storey behemoth in Manhattan.
examples.zh: 她在曼哈顿一栋七十层的庞然大楼里工作。

examples.en: She didn't like to be beholden to anyone.
examples.zh: 她不愿欠任何人的人情。

meanings: 给人以不符实情的印象
表明某说法不实，与之矛盾

examples.en: My calm exterior belies my deep inner fear.
examples.zh: 我平静的外表掩盖了内心深深的恐惧。

meanings: 使显得不真实（belie 的第三人称单数）

examples.en: She felt her husband constantly belittled her achievements.
examples.zh: 她觉得丈夫不断贬低她的成就。

examples.en: He is always very belligerent towards me.
examples.zh: 他总是对我抱有强烈敌意。

examples.en: They sat bemoaning the fact that no one would give them a chance.
examples.zh: 他们坐在那里哀叹没有人肯给他们一个机会。

examples.en: The lamp post got bent in the crash.
examples.zh: 灯柱在撞击中弯了。

examples.en: She seems bent on making life difficult for me.
examples.zh: 她似乎一心要让我日子不好过。

examples.en: The ceremony was an ordeal for those who had been recently bereaved.
examples.zh: 对那些刚失去亲人的人而言，这场仪式是一种煎熬。

examples.en: It was a title bestowed upon him by the king.
examples.zh: 那是国王授予他的头衔。

examples.en: He was offered money to betray his colleagues.
examples.zh: 有人提出给他钱，让他背叛同事。

examples.en: His voice betrayed the worry he was trying to hide.
examples.zh: 他的声音暴露了他试图掩饰的担忧。

examples.en: She was totally bewildered by his sudden change of mood.
examples.zh: 他的情绪突然变化，使她完全摸不着头脑。

examples.en: Employers must consider all candidates impartially and without bias.
examples.zh: 雇主必须公正而不带偏见地考虑所有候选人。

examples.en: The book gives potted biographies of all the major painters.
examples.zh: 这本书简要介绍了所有主要画家的生平。

examples.en: He was appointed Bishop of Ely.
examples.zh: 他被任命为伊利主教。

examples.en: Black coffee leaves a bitter taste in the mouth.
examples.zh: 黑咖啡在嘴里留下苦味。

examples.en: She is very bitter about losing her job.
examples.zh: 她对失去工作非常愤愤不平。

examples.en: The weather turned bitter.
examples.zh: 天气变得严寒。

meanings: 另为blame的过去式及过去分词，责备

examples.en: None of us is entirely blameless in this matter.
examples.zh: 这件事上，我们谁都不是完全没有过错的。

examples.en: This sauce is rather bland.
examples.zh: 这种酱味道相当清淡。

examples.en: It was a blatant lie.
examples.zh: 那是个公然的谎言。

examples.en: Prospects for the industry are extremely bleak.
examples.zh: 该行业的前景极不乐观。

examples.en: His reputation is without a blemish.
examples.zh: 他的声誉没有任何污点。

examples.en: She had been bludgeoned to death.
examples.zh: 她被钝器重击致死。

examples.en: They tried to bludgeon me into joining their protest.
examples.zh: 他们试图强迫我参加他们的抗议。

examples.en: Sam boasted that she could beat anyone at poker.
examples.zh: 萨姆吹嘘自己打扑克能赢任何人。

examples.en: Rhodes boasts 300 days of sunshine a year.
examples.zh: 罗得岛每年有300天的阳光，令人称羡。

examples.en: Bogus claims of injury by workers are costing companies thousands of pounds.
examples.zh: 工人虚报受伤的索赔使公司损失数千英镑。

examples.en: It was a challenge, keeping ten boisterous 7-year-olds amused.
examples.zh: 要让十个活泼喧闹的七岁孩子玩得开心，是一项挑战。

examples.en: Quiet and bookish, he was sometimes teased by the other boys.
examples.zh: 他安静而爱读书，有时会被其他男孩取笑。

examples.en: He completely botched up the interview.
examples.zh: 他把面试彻底搞砸了。

examples.en: A karate bout lasts for two or three minutes.
examples.zh: 一场空手道比赛持续两三分钟。

examples.en: He suffered occasional bouts of depression.
examples.zh: 他偶尔会陷入一阵抑郁。

examples.en: He bragged to his friends about the crime.
examples.zh: 他向朋友吹嘘自己犯下的罪行。

meanings: 独创的主意、计划或作品

examples.en: The TV programme was the brainchild of the producer.
examples.zh: 这个电视节目是那位制片人的创意。

examples.en: She estimated the breadth of the lake to be 500 metres.
examples.zh: 她估计湖面宽500米。

examples.en: I was surprised at the breadth of his reading.
examples.zh: 我惊讶于他的阅读范围之广。

examples.en: She had been offered a $50 000 bribe to drop the charges.
examples.zh: 有人出价五万美元贿赂她，要她撤销指控。

examples.en: She was arrested on bribery charges.
examples.zh: 她因贿赂指控被捕。

examples.en: She held his stirrup for him while Adam took the bridle.
examples.zh: 亚当牵住马笼头时，她为他扶着马镫。

examples.en: The road goes over a small brook.
examples.zh: 这条路跨过一条小溪。

examples.en: The doctor spoke in a brusque tone.
examples.zh: 医生说话的语气简短而生硬。

meanings: 田园的，乡村的，牧歌式的

examples.en: The dog refused to budge.
examples.zh: 那只狗不肯挪动。

examples.en: She was not to be budged on her decision.
examples.zh: 她不肯改变自己的决定。

examples.en: His eyes bulged.
examples.zh: 他的眼睛瞪了出来。

examples.en: Her pockets were bulging with presents.
examples.zh: 她的口袋塞满了礼物，鼓鼓囊囊的。

meanings: 堡垒，防护屏障，坚强保障

examples.en: At the time fascism had many supporters in the West, who saw it as a bulwark against communism.
examples.zh: 当时，法西斯主义在西方有许多支持者，他们将其视为抵挡共产主义的屏障。

meanings: 繁重的，造成负担的，难以承受的

examples.en: The new regulations will be burdensome for small businesses.
examples.zh: 新规定将给小企业带来沉重负担。

examples.en: She works for an employment bureau.
examples.zh: 她在一家职业介绍所工作。

examples.en: We need to reduce paperwork and bureaucracy in the company.
examples.zh: 我们需要减少公司里的文书工作和繁文缛节。

examples.en: New running clubs have burgeoned over the past decade.
examples.zh: 过去十年里，新的跑步俱乐部迅速涌现。

examples.en: The hedgerows had begun to burgeon with violets and primroses.
examples.zh: 树篱间开始长出繁茂的紫罗兰和报春花。

examples.en: Don't burst that balloon!
examples.zh: 别把那个气球弄破！

examples.en: He burst into the room without knocking.
examples.zh: 他没有敲门就冲进了房间。

examples.en: She adopted a brisk businesslike tone.
examples.zh: 她采用了一种干脆、公事公办的语气。

examples.en: I bust my camera.
examples.zh: 我把相机弄坏了。

examples.en: He's been busted for fraud.
examples.zh: 他因诈骗被捕了。

examples.en: It was necessary to strengthen the building with large external buttresses.
examples.zh: 有必要用大型外部扶壁加固这栋建筑。

examples.en: It was accidentally printed under the wrong byline.
examples.zh: 这篇文章误印了别人的署名。

examples.en: The name Chanel became a byword for elegance.
examples.zh: 香奈儿这个名字成为优雅的代名词。

examples.en: The china was displayed in a glass cabinet.
examples.zh: 瓷器陈列在玻璃柜中。

examples.en: No other brand name has quite the same cachet.
examples.zh: 没有其他品牌享有完全同样的声望。

meanings: 用好话或温和劝说哄劝

examples.en: He cajoled me into agreeing to do the work.
examples.zh: 他用好话哄得我答应做这项工作。

examples.en: The country suffered a series of calamities during the 1980s.
examples.zh: 这个国家在20世纪80年代遭受了一连串灾难。

examples.en: This was clearly a calculated attempt to discredit the company.
examples.zh: 这显然是一次蓄意败坏公司声誉的企图。

examples.en: Her latest play is calculated to shock.
examples.zh: 她最新的剧作就是要令人震惊。

meanings: 年轻而缺乏经验的，幼稚的

examples.en: Her voice was surprisingly calm.
examples.zh: 她的声音平静得令人惊讶。

examples.en: The weather was calm and dry.
examples.zh: 天气无风而干燥。

examples.en: He accused the press of publishing vicious calumnies.
examples.zh: 他指责媒体刊登恶毒的诽谤言论。

examples.en: The whiteness of polar bears and arctic foxes provides camouflage.
examples.zh: 北极熊和北极狐白色的外表起到了伪装作用。

examples.en: He was canny enough to see that they were trying to trap him.
examples.zh: 他很精明，看出他们正试图让他上当。

examples.en: They had to contend with capricious economic forces.
examples.zh: 他们不得不应对反复无常的经济力量。

meanings: 故意设难使人陷入争辩的

examples.en: The children were captivated by her stories.
examples.zh: 孩子们被她的故事深深吸引。

meanings: 受控制、无法自由离开的

examples.en: She was held captive in a castle.
examples.zh: 她被囚禁在一座城堡里。

meanings: 癌（源自上皮组织的恶性肿瘤）
夸张讽刺的画像或描述

examples.en: He had unfairly presented a caricature of my views.
examples.zh: 他歪曲地夸张描述了我的观点，这不公平。

meanings: 共同乘车的安排或人员

examples.en: He castigated himself for being so thoughtless.
examples.zh: 他严厉责备自己考虑如此不周。

meanings: 促成或加速变化的人或事

examples.en: Chlorine will act as a catalyst.
examples.zh: 氯会起催化剂的作用。

examples.en: I see my role as being a catalyst for change.
examples.zh: 我把自己的角色看作促成变革的人。

examples.en: They gave him a categorical assurance that he would not be hurt.
examples.zh: 他们向他作出明确保证，他不会受到伤害。

examples.en: Who will be catering the wedding?
examples.zh: 谁将为婚礼提供餐饮服务？

meanings: 发出刺耳的叫声（caterwaul 的现在分词）

examples.en: Are they Catholic or Protestant?
examples.zh: 他们是天主教徒还是新教徒？

examples.en: Her speech was a caustic attack on government officials.
examples.zh: 她的演讲对政府官员进行了尖刻的攻击。

examples.en: Cuba was ceded by Spain to the US in 1898.
examples.zh: 西班牙在1898年将古巴割让给美国。

examples.en: Use a mixture of one part cement to four parts sand.
examples.zh: 使用一份水泥配四份沙子的混合物。

meanings: 审查并删去被认为不妥的内容

examples.en: The opposition forced a vote of censure on the government's foreign policy.
examples.zh: 反对派迫使议会就政府的外交政策进行谴责投票。

examples.en: His poetry is very cerebral.
examples.zh: 他的诗歌很重理性。

examples.en: ‘You will like Rome,’ he said, with absolute certitude.
examples.zh: “你会喜欢罗马的，”他满怀确信地说。

meanings: 使恼怒（chafe 的现在分词）
餐桌上用于加热或保温食物的器皿
因失望、失败或受辱而懊恼

examples.en: To my chagrin, nobody wanted to hear me sing.
examples.zh: 令我懊恼的是，没有人想听我唱歌。

examples.en: She was a long-term champion of animal rights and environmental protection.
examples.zh: 她长期致力于维护动物权利和环境保护。

examples.en: Their whole marriage had been a charade—they had never loved each other.
examples.zh: 他们的整个婚姻都是一场虚假的表演——他们从未爱过彼此。

examples.en: Let's play charades.
examples.zh: 我们来玩字谜表演游戏吧。

examples.en: The president has great personal charisma.
examples.zh: 这位总统极具个人魅力。

examples.en: He knows nothing about medicine—he’s a complete charlatan.
examples.zh: 他对医学一窍不通——完全是个冒牌医生。

examples.en: The accompanying chart shows data for eight countries.
examples.zh: 附图显示了八个国家的数据。

meanings: 不轻易给予、接受或耗费的

examples.en: He chastised the team for their lack of commitment.
examples.zh: 他严厉责备了团队缺乏投入的表现。

examples.en: He plays a chauvinistic pig of an advertising executive.
examples.zh: 他饰演一个大男子主义十足的广告公司主管。

examples.en: She cites the economy as her chief concern.
examples.zh: 她说经济是她最关心的问题。

examples.en: He became chief engineer of the Great Western Railway.
examples.zh: 他成为大西部铁路公司的总工程师。

examples.en: I was only trying to be chivalrous.
examples.zh: 我只是想表现得有骑士风度。

meanings: 精心安排活动的步骤或细节

examples.en: She choreographed several ballets for the company.
examples.zh: 她为这家舞团编排了几部芭蕾舞剧。

examples.en: The child was christened Mary.
examples.zh: 那个孩子受洗时被命名为玛丽。

examples.en: They christened the boat ‘Oceania’.
examples.zh: 他们给那条船起名为“大洋洲号”。

examples.en: Her latest novel is a chronicle of life in a Devon village.
examples.zh: 她最新的小说记述了德文郡一个村庄的生活。

examples.en: It would be churlish to refuse such a generous offer.
examples.zh: 拒绝如此慷慨的提议会显得很无礼。

examples.en: The first question is a cinch.
examples.zh: 第一道题轻而易举。

examples.en: He's a cinch to win the race.
examples.zh: 他稳操胜券，一定能赢得比赛。

examples.en: He took us on a circuitous route to the hotel.
examples.zh: 他带我们绕道去了旅馆。

examples.en: The power of the monarchy was circumscribed by the new law.
examples.zh: 新法律限制了君主的权力。

examples.en: Voting should be a matter of civic duty.
examples.zh: 投票应该被视为公民义务。

examples.en: Staff members are trained to treat customers with civility at all times.
examples.zh: 员工接受培训，随时都要礼貌地对待顾客。

examples.en: She didn’t waste time on civilities.
examples.zh: 她没有把时间浪费在客套上。

examples.en: Clamp the two halves together until the glue dries.
examples.zh: 把两半夹紧在一起，直到胶水干透。

examples.en: The brilliant clarity of his argument could not be faulted.
examples.zh: 他论证的清晰透彻无可挑剔。

meanings: 古希腊罗马文化相关的

examples.en: The wound was then cleansed and dressed.
examples.zh: 随后，伤口经过清洗并包扎。

examples.en: She felt cleansed of her sins after confession.
examples.zh: 忏悔之后，她感觉自己的罪孽被洗净了。

examples.en: The huge boat cleaved the darkness.
examples.zh: 巨大的船划破了黑暗。

examples.en: Her tongue clove to the roof of her mouth.
examples.zh: 她的舌头紧贴着上颚。

examples.en: The club is dominated by a small clique of intellectuals.
examples.zh: 这个俱乐部由一小群排外的知识分子主导。

examples.en: She threw a heavy cloak over her shoulders.
examples.zh: 她把一件厚斗篷披在肩上。

examples.en: They left under the cloak of darkness.
examples.zh: 他们在夜色的掩护下离开了。

examples.en: The narrow streets were clogged with traffic.
examples.zh: 狭窄的街道交通堵塞。

meanings: 因过甜、过多或过度感伤而令人厌倦

examples.en: After a while, the rich sauce begins to cloy.
examples.zh: 过了一会儿，浓厚的酱汁开始令人发腻。

meanings: 一簇，一群，一组相近的事物

examples.en: The plant bears its flowers in clusters.
examples.zh: 这种植物的花成簇开放。

examples.en: He clutched the child to him.
examples.zh: 他把孩子紧紧搂在怀里。

examples.en: The markets have coalesced into a single global market.
examples.zh: 各个市场已经合并成一个全球市场。

examples.en: I dressed in my finest blue wool coat.
examples.zh: 我穿上了自己最好的蓝色羊毛外套。

examples.en: They were coerced into negotiating a settlement.
examples.zh: 他们被迫谈判以达成和解。

examples.en: She put forward some cogent reasons for abandoning the plan.
examples.zh: 她提出了一些令人信服的理由，主张放弃这个计划。

examples.en: He has done extensive research into theories of human cognition.
examples.zh: 他对人类认知理论进行了广泛研究。

examples.en: You're not being very coherent.
examples.zh: 你说得不太清楚。

examples.en: They flipped a coin to see who should go first.
examples.zh: 他们抛硬币决定谁先来。

examples.en: These parallels cannot be merely coincidental.
examples.zh: 这些相似之处不可能只是巧合。

examples.en: Two trains collided head-on.
examples.zh: 两列火车迎头相撞。

examples.en: They regularly collide over policy decisions.
examples.zh: 他们经常在政策决定上发生冲突。

meanings: 胶体的，具有胶体性质的

examples.en: Several people had colluded in the murder.
examples.zh: 几个人合谋实施了那起谋杀。

examples.en: The singer earns a colossal amount of money.
examples.zh: 这位歌手赚取了巨额收入。

examples.en: He was killed in combat.
examples.zh: 他在战斗中阵亡。

examples.en: The lawyers were in a combative mood, fiercely determined to put forward their case.
examples.zh: 律师们气势汹汹，坚决要陈述己方的案情。

examples.en: Poisonous gases are produced during fossil fuel combustion.
examples.zh: 化石燃料燃烧时会产生有毒气体。

examples.en: This administration pledges to do its best to foster comity and bipartisanship.
examples.zh: 本届政府承诺尽力促进友好合作与两党协作。

examples.en: Begin when I give the command.
examples.zh: 等我下令后再开始。

examples.en: She has an excellent command of French.
examples.zh: 她精通法语。

examples.en: The soldiers had commandeered the farm and the villa five months ago.
examples.zh: 士兵们五个月前就征用了农场和别墅。

examples.en: His book was highly commended.
examples.zh: 他的书受到了高度赞扬。

examples.en: We commend her soul to God.
examples.zh: 我们把她的灵魂托付给上帝。

examples.en: I was listening to the radio commentary on the game.
examples.zh: 我当时正在听比赛的广播解说。

examples.en: She commiserated with the losers on their defeat.
examples.zh: 她对失败者的落败表示同情。

examples.en: I offered him my commiseration.
examples.zh: 我向他表示了同情。

examples.en: She was criticized for her lack of commitment.
examples.zh: 她因不够投入而受到批评。

examples.en: Crude oil is the world's most important commodity.
examples.zh: 原油是世界上最重要的大宗商品。

examples.en: Time is a very valuable commodity.
examples.zh: 时间是一种极为宝贵的资源。

examples.en: This technology is now commonplace in schools.
examples.zh: 这项技术现在在学校中很常见。

examples.en: What's all the commotion about?
examples.zh: 这是在吵闹什么？

examples.en: She commutes from Oxford to London every day.
examples.zh: 她每天往返牛津和伦敦通勤。

examples.en: The death sentence was commuted to life imprisonment.
examples.zh: 死刑被减为终身监禁。

examples.en: The two machines are comparable in size.
examples.zh: 这两台机器大小相当。

examples.en: The unit is comparatively easy to install and cheap to operate.
examples.zh: 这个装置安装起来相对容易，运行费用也低。

meanings: 将思想或活动彼此分开

examples.en: Life today is rigidly compartmentalized into work and leisure.
examples.zh: 当今生活被严格分成工作和休闲两部分。

examples.en: In an overworked doctor, feelings of compassion are soon lost.
examples.zh: 医生过度劳累时，同情心很快就会消失。

examples.en: The court has powers to compel witnesses to attend.
examples.zh: 法院有权强制证人出庭。

examples.en: The new studies provide compelling evidence in support of these concepts.
examples.zh: 新的研究为这些观点提供了有力的证据。

examples.en: Her latest book makes compelling reading.
examples.zh: 她最新的书读起来引人入胜。

examples.en: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a loved one.
examples.zh: 什么也无法弥补失去至亲的痛苦。

examples.en: How staff are compensated makes a big difference in performance.
examples.zh: 员工得到怎样的报酬，会对工作表现产生很大影响。

examples.en: We are trying to compile a list of suitable people for the job.
examples.zh: 我们正在编写一份适合这项工作的人选名单。

meanings: 自满的，安于现状而缺乏警觉的

examples.en: We must not become complacent about progress.
examples.zh: 我们不能因已有的进展而自满。

examples.en: This site is HTML-compliant.
examples.zh: 这个网站符合HTML规范。

examples.en: She was extremely complimentary about his work.
examples.zh: 她对他的工作极尽赞美。

examples.en: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast buffet.
examples.zh: 酒店提供免费自助早餐。

examples.en: They refused to comply with the UN resolution.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝遵守联合国决议。

examples.en: She seemed outwardly composed.
examples.zh: 她表面上显得很镇定。

examples.en: He stood staring at the dead body, unable to comprehend.
examples.zh: 他站在那里盯着尸体，无法理解眼前的一切。

examples.en: The hydrogen gas is then compressed into a liquid.
examples.zh: 随后氢气被压缩成液体。

examples.en: The main arguments were compressed into one chapter.
examples.zh: 主要论点被浓缩到一个章节里。

examples.en: The collection comprises 327 paintings.
examples.zh: 这批收藏包括327幅画。

examples.en: Older people comprise a large proportion of those living in poverty.
examples.zh: 老年人在贫困人口中占很大比例。

examples.en: Compromise is an inevitable part of life.
examples.zh: 妥协是生活中不可避免的一部分。

meanings: （因道德顾虑而产生的）犹豫，顾忌

examples.en: He had lied to her without compunction.
examples.zh: 他毫无愧疚地对她撒了谎。

examples.en: The so-called bargain was just a big con!
examples.zh: 那所谓的便宜货只是一场大骗局！

examples.en: We weighed up the pros and cons.
examples.zh: 我们权衡了利弊。

examples.en: Tim could barely conceal his disappointment.
examples.zh: 蒂姆几乎掩饰不住自己的失望。

examples.en: I had to concede the logic of this.
examples.zh: 我不得不承认其中的逻辑。

examples.en: Injury forced Hicks to concede defeat.
examples.zh: 受伤迫使希克斯认输。

examples.en: It is conceivable that I'll see her tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天可能会见到她。

examples.en: The dam project was originally conceived in 1997.
examples.zh: 大坝项目最初于1997年构想提出。

examples.en: She is unable to conceive.
examples.zh: 她无法受孕。

examples.en: They also performed at a concert in Rome last month.
examples.zh: 他们上个月还在罗马的一场音乐会上演出了。

examples.en: The company has just won a mining concession in the north of the country.
examples.zh: 这家公司刚获得该国北部一处矿区的开采特许权。

examples.en: A conciliation service helps to settle disputes between employers and workers.
examples.zh: 调解服务机构帮助解决雇主与工人之间的争端。

examples.en: She gave us clear and concise instructions.
examples.zh: 她给了我们清楚而简洁的指示。

examples.en: The evidence is by no means conclusive.
examples.zh: 这些证据远不足以下定论。

examples.en: She concocted some elaborate story to explain her absence.
examples.zh: 她编造了一个复杂的故事来解释自己的缺席。

examples.en: The soup was concocted from up to a dozen different kinds of fish.
examples.zh: 这道汤由多达十二种不同的鱼调制而成。

examples.en: She suffered a mild concussion.
examples.zh: 她受了轻微脑震荡。

examples.en: The government issued a statement condemning the killings.
examples.zh: 政府发表声明谴责这些杀人事件。

examples.en: The meat was condemned as unfit to eat.
examples.zh: 这些肉被认定不宜食用。

examples.en: He was condemned to a life of hardship.
examples.zh: 他注定要过艰苦的生活。

examples.en: He has a condescending attitude towards women.
examples.zh: 他对女性抱着居高临下的态度。

meanings: 应得的，适当的（尤指惩罚）
宽恕、容忍或纵容（明知不当的行为）

examples.en: The college does not condone such behaviour.
examples.zh: 学院不容忍这种行为。

meanings: 为某种目的结成的集团

examples.en: An honorary degree was conferred on him by Oxford University in 2019.
examples.zh: 牛津大学于2019年授予他荣誉学位。

examples.en: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
examples.zh: 作决定前，他想先与同事商议。

examples.en: The work will not be confined to the Glasgow area.
examples.zh: 这项工作不会局限于格拉斯哥地区。

examples.en: Keep the dog confined in a suitable travelling cage.
examples.zh: 把狗关在合适的旅行笼里。

examples.en: Their land was confiscated after the war.
examples.zh: 他们的土地在战争后被没收了。

examples.en: The issues of race and class are separate and should not be conflated.
examples.zh: 种族和阶级是两个不同的问题，不应该混为一谈。

examples.en: He refused to conform to the local customs.
examples.zh: 他拒绝遵从当地习俗。

examples.en: The building does not conform with safety regulations.
examples.zh: 这栋建筑不符合安全规定。

examples.en: The sudden rise in share prices has confounded economists.
examples.zh: 股价突然上涨让经济学家困惑不解。

examples.en: The rise in share prices confounded expectations.
examples.zh: 股价的上涨出乎意料。

examples.en: She knew that she had to confront her fears.
examples.zh: 她知道自己必须面对恐惧。

examples.en: The cold remains of supper had congealed on the plate.
examples.zh: 冷掉的晚餐残余在盘子里凝结了。

examples.en: The bitterness and tears had congealed into hatred.
examples.zh: 痛苦和泪水逐渐凝结成了仇恨。

examples.en: His studies in Leiden proved congenial to him.
examples.zh: 他发现在莱顿的学习很合心意。

examples.en: Young people often congregate in the main square in the evenings.
examples.zh: 年轻人常常在晚上聚集在主广场上。

meanings: 集体服务或集体居住的

examples.en: Congress will vote on the proposals tomorrow.
examples.zh: 国会将于明天就这些提案投票。

examples.en: The measures are congruent with the changes in management policy.
examples.zh: 这些措施与管理政策的变化一致。

examples.en: The truth of his conjecture was confirmed by the newspaper report.
examples.zh: 报纸的报道证实了他的推测。

examples.en: Her grandfather taught her to conjure.
examples.zh: 她的祖父教她变魔术。

meanings: 变魔术般地变出（conjure 的第三人称单数）

examples.en: She knew that if she said nothing she would be conniving in an injustice.
examples.zh: 她知道，如果自己保持沉默，就是在纵容不公。

examples.en: This is a gift that any wine connoisseur would love.
examples.zh: 这是任何葡萄酒鉴赏家都会喜欢的礼物。

meanings: 带有字面义之外的含义

examples.en: It's a brand name that connotes luxury.
examples.zh: 这是一个让人联想到奢华的品牌名称。

examples.en: She was a popular and conscientious teacher.
examples.zh: 她是一位受欢迎且认真负责的教师。

examples.en: They have always governed by consensus.
examples.zh: 他们一直通过协商一致来治理。

examples.en: Have you considered the possible consequences?
examples.zh: 你考虑过可能的后果吗？

examples.en: Road development in the area has been limited by conservation programmes.
examples.zh: 该地区的道路开发因保护计划而受到限制。

examples.en: These findings are consistent with other studies.
examples.zh: 这些发现与其他研究一致。

examples.en: Defence spending levels have remained consistent.
examples.zh: 国防开支水平一直保持稳定。

meanings: 显眼的，显著的，引人注意的

examples.en: I felt very conspicuous in my new car.
examples.zh: 坐在新车里，我觉得自己很引人注目。

examples.en: They were accused of conspiring against the king.
examples.zh: 他们被指控密谋反对国王。

examples.en: Everything conspired to make her life a misery.
examples.zh: 种种事情凑在一起，使她的生活苦不堪言。

examples.en: Have you finished your report, Constable?
examples.zh: 警员，你的报告写完了吗？

examples.en: There were constant interruptions.
examples.zh: 不断有人打断。

examples.en: The samples need to be stored at a constant temperature.
examples.zh: 这些样本需要在恒温下保存。

examples.en: Ross was his most constant and loyal friend.
examples.zh: 罗斯是他最忠诚可靠的朋友。

examples.en: Research has been constrained by a lack of funds.
examples.zh: 资金匮乏限制了研究。

examples.en: The company said that it was constrained to raise prices.
examples.zh: 公司表示，不得不提高价格。

examples.en: Film-makers of the time were constricted by the censors.
examples.zh: 当时的电影制作人受到审查人员的限制。

examples.en: These substances can contaminate groundwater.
examples.zh: 这些物质会污染地下水。

examples.en: He sat there deep in contemplation.
examples.zh: 他坐在那里，陷入沉思。

examples.en: Try some contemporary colours on your kitchen walls.
examples.zh: 试着给厨房墙壁用一些现代的颜色。

examples.en: He was contemporary with the dramatist Congreve.
examples.zh: 他与剧作家康格里夫生活在同一时代。

examples.en: She gave him a contemptuous look.
examples.zh: 她轻蔑地看了他一眼。

examples.en: He was a contented man.
examples.zh: 他是个知足的人。

examples.en: Both views are highly contentious.
examples.zh: 这两种观点都很有争议。

examples.en: The countries are contiguous.
examples.zh: 这些国家彼此接壤。

examples.en: The largest contingent was from the United States.
examples.zh: 最大的代表团来自美国。

examples.en: The French contingent in the UN peacekeeping force withdrew.
examples.zh: 联合国维和部队中的法国分遣队撤离了。

examples.en: She traced the contours of his face with her finger.
examples.zh: 她用手指沿着他的脸部轮廓轻轻划过。

examples.en: These clauses form part of the contract between buyer and seller.
examples.zh: 这些条款构成买卖双方合同的一部分。

examples.en: The company was found guilty of contravening safety regulations.
examples.zh: 该公司被判违反了安全规定。

examples.en: Her expression was contrite.
examples.zh: 她的表情充满悔意。

examples.en: They contrived a plan to defraud the company.
examples.zh: 他们想出了一个诈骗公司的计划。

examples.en: Somehow they contrived to live on her tiny income.
examples.zh: 他们总算设法靠她微薄的收入维持生活。

meanings: 顽抗权威的，固执不服从的

examples.en: The role of clouds is one of the big conundrums of climatology.
examples.zh: 云的作用是气候学中的重大难题之一。

examples.en: She spent her whole life in a convent.
examples.zh: 她一生都在女修道院中度过。

examples.en: She's very conventional in her views.
examples.zh: 她的看法非常传统。

examples.en: There was a signpost where the two paths converged.
examples.zh: 两条小路交汇处有一个路标。

examples.en: The aims of the two developments can and should converge.
examples.zh: 这两项开发的目标能够也应该趋于一致。

examples.en: You need to become fully conversant with the company's procedures.
examples.zh: 你需要充分熟悉公司的程序。

examples.en: She was motivated by deep religious conviction.
examples.zh: 她受到深厚宗教信念的激励。

examples.en: He plans to appeal against his conviction.
examples.zh: 他打算对有罪判决提出上诉。

examples.en: Alan was convivial, affable and engaging.
examples.zh: 艾伦爱交际、和蔼而有魅力。

meanings: 欢乐友好的气氛、欢聚之乐

examples.en: I had to negotiate an amazingly convoluted one-way system.
examples.zh: 我不得不穿行于一套极其复杂的单行道系统。

examples.en: I took copious notes.
examples.zh: 我记了大量笔记。

examples.en: The talks took place in a cordial atmosphere.
examples.zh: 会谈在友好的气氛中进行。

examples.en: I was greeted with a show of cordiality.
examples.zh: 我受到了热情的迎接。

meanings: 最重要的基础或组成部分

examples.en: This study is the cornerstone of the whole research programme.
examples.zh: 这项研究是整个研究计划的基石。

examples.en: In rural areas, the corollary of increased car ownership has been a rapid decline in the provision of public transport.
examples.zh: 在农村地区，汽车保有量增加带来的结果是公共交通供给迅速下降。

examples.en: The corpse was barely recognizable.
examples.zh: 那具尸体几乎已无法辨认。

meanings: （英国戏剧俚语）在台上笑场或使人笑场

examples.en: We have been in correspondence for months.
examples.zh: 我们通信已有几个月了。

examples.en: There is a close correspondence between the two extracts.
examples.zh: 这两个摘录非常吻合。

examples.en: The whole system is inefficient and corrupt.
examples.zh: 整个体系既低效又腐败。

examples.en: The file on the disk seems to be corrupt.
examples.zh: 磁盘上的文件似乎损坏了。

examples.en: Young people today are much more cosmopolitan.
examples.zh: 今天的年轻人更加见多识广。

examples.en: As a child, she had been spoiled and cosseted.
examples.zh: 她小时候受到溺爱和娇养。

meanings: 志趣相投的小圈子，小团体

examples.en: Her work attracted a coterie of admirers in the US.
examples.zh: 她的作品吸引了美国的一小群仰慕者。

examples.en: They sat down on the wide couch.
examples.zh: 他们在宽大的沙发上坐下。

examples.en: Are you aware these notes are counterfeit?
examples.zh: 你知道这些钞票是假的吗？

meanings: 违反直觉预期的，反直觉的

examples.en: He appeared to be countermanding orders as fast as they were given.
examples.zh: 命令刚下达，他似乎就立刻撤销。

examples.en: The Foreign Minister held talks with his Chinese counterpart.
examples.zh: 外交部长与中国同行举行了会谈。

meanings: 适得其反的，妨碍预期目标的

examples.en: Increases in taxation would be counterproductive.
examples.zh: 加税会适得其反。

examples.en: Relatives of the victims were in court.
examples.zh: 受害者的亲属在法庭内。

examples.en: He was presented to the queen at court.
examples.zh: 他在宫廷中被引见给女王。

examples.en: The players are good friends off court and train together.
examples.zh: 这些选手在球场外是好朋友，一起训练。

examples.en: The hotel staff are friendly and courteous.
examples.zh: 酒店员工友好而有礼貌。

examples.en: He stole a covert glance at her across the table.
examples.zh: 他隔着桌子偷偷瞥了她一眼。

examples.en: He had long coveted the chance to work with a famous musician.
examples.zh: 他长期以来一直渴望有机会与一位著名音乐家合作。

examples.en: She was ashamed of her cowardice.
examples.zh: 她为自己的怯懦感到羞愧。

examples.en: The dog whimpered and cowered at his feet.
examples.zh: 那只狗呜咽着，蜷缩在他脚边。

meanings: 忸怩害羞的，故作羞怯的

examples.en: She gave me a coy smile.
examples.zh: 她冲我羞怯地一笑。

examples.en: The company is coy about revealing its profits.
examples.zh: 公司不愿透露利润。

meanings: （字迹或文字）难辨认、难理解的

examples.en: He's a crafty old devil.
examples.zh: 他是个狡猾的老家伙。

examples.en: I thought his comments were somewhat crass.
examples.zh: 我觉得他的评论有些粗俗无知。

examples.en: The spider was found hiding in a crate of bananas.
examples.zh: 那只蜘蛛被发现躲在一箱香蕉里。

examples.en: She has always craved excitement.
examples.zh: 她一直渴望刺激。

examples.en: I must crave your pardon.
examples.zh: 我必须恳求你的原谅。

meanings: 轻信的，容易信以为真的
因恐惧、厌恶或尴尬畏缩
卑躬屈膝的，畏缩讨好的
严重损害，使失去正常功能

examples.en: The industry has been financially crippled by these policies.
examples.zh: 这些政策使这个行业在财务上受到重创。

examples.en: The main criterion is value for money.
examples.zh: 主要的评判标准是性价比。

meanings: 柔声吟唱（croon 的现在分词）

examples.en: Crumble the cheese over the salad.
examples.zh: 把奶酪掰碎撒在沙拉上。

examples.en: All his hopes began to crumble away.
examples.zh: 他所有的希望开始破灭。

examples.en: Savour the culinary delights of Mexico.
examples.zh: 品味墨西哥的美食佳肴吧。

meanings: 最终导致或以某事告终

examples.en: Months of hard work culminated in success.
examples.zh: 几个月的辛勤工作最终取得了成功。

meanings: 有过错而应承担责任的

examples.en: The accident was the result of a culpable failure to consider the risks involved.
examples.zh: 这起事故是没有考虑相关风险这一应受责备的疏失所致。

examples.en: The police quickly identified the real culprits.
examples.zh: 警方很快查明了真正的罪犯。

examples.en: The main culprit in the current crisis seems to be modern farming techniques.
examples.zh: 当前危机的主要祸因似乎是现代农业技术。

examples.en: The organization changed its cumbersome title to something easier to remember.
examples.zh: 该组织把繁琐的名称改成了更容易记住的名称。

examples.en: He was as cunning as a fox.
examples.zh: 他像狐狸一样狡猾。

examples.en: It was a cunning piece of detective work.
examples.zh: 那是一项巧妙的侦查工作。

meanings: 博物馆或展览机构的馆长

examples.en: He muttered a curse at the other driver.
examples.zh: 他低声咒骂了另一个司机。

examples.en: Noise is a curse of modern city life.
examples.zh: 噪声是现代城市生活的一大祸害。

examples.en: His tone was curt and unfriendly.
examples.zh: 他的语气生硬而不友好。

examples.en: I rested my elbow on a cushion.
examples.zh: 我把肘部靠在垫子上。

examples.en: His savings were a comfortable cushion against financial problems.
examples.zh: 他的积蓄为应对财务问题提供了充足的缓冲。

examples.en: All our aircraft carry at least one oxygen cylinder for emergency use on board.
examples.zh: 我们所有的飞机都携带至少一个氧气瓶，供机上紧急使用。

examples.en: I'm a little cynical about her motives.
examples.zh: 我对她的动机有点怀疑。

examples.en: Such behaviour helps breed cynicism among the electorate.
examples.zh: 这种行为助长了选民的愤世嫉俗。

examples.en: The cottage was cold and damp.
examples.zh: 这间小屋又冷又潮。

examples.en: Perspiration dampened her face and neck.
examples.zh: 汗水浸湿了她的脸和脖子。

examples.en: They spend the evening playing darts in the pub.
examples.zh: 他们整个晚上在酒吧里玩飞镖。

examples.en: These ideas seem a bit dated now.
examples.zh: 这些想法现在显得有点过时。

meanings: 令人畏惧的，使人望而却步的

examples.en: There was a dearth of reliable information on the subject.
examples.zh: 有关这个问题的可靠信息很匮乏。

examples.en: He should take responsibility for the debacle and resign.
examples.zh: 他应该为这次惨败负责并辞职。

examples.en: Sport is being debased by commercial sponsorship.
examples.zh: 商业赞助正在降低体育的品质。

meanings: 使虚弱，削弱力量或功能

examples.en: The troops were severely debilitated by hunger and disease.
examples.zh: 饥饿和疾病使部队严重虚弱。

examples.en: His theories have been debunked by recent research.
examples.zh: 最近的研究已驳倒了他的理论。

examples.en: There was something very decadent about filling ourselves with so much rich food.
examples.zh: 我们吃了那么多丰盛的食物，颇有些纵情享乐的意味。

examples.en: The decay of the wood will spread if it is not removed.
examples.zh: 木材的腐烂部分若不移除，腐烂就会蔓延。

examples.en: Radioactive decay happens at a constant rate regardless of exposure to air.
examples.zh: 放射性衰变以恒定速率发生，与是否暴露于空气无关。

examples.en: The government were accused of being hypocritical and deceitful.
examples.zh: 政府被指责虚伪且不诚实。

examples.en: Economic growth decelerated sharply in June.
examples.zh: 六月的经济增长速度大幅放缓。

examples.en: He was accused of obtaining property by deception.
examples.zh: 他被指控通过欺骗获取财产。

examples.en: The firm was found guilty of publishing a misleading and deceptive advertisement.
examples.zh: 该公司被认定发布了误导性和欺骗性的广告。

examples.en: The rabbit population was decimated by the disease.
examples.zh: 这种疾病使兔子数量锐减。

examples.en: They were able to decipher the French military codes.
examples.zh: 他们成功破译了法国军事密码。

examples.en: Can anyone decipher his handwriting?
examples.zh: 有人能辨认他的字迹吗？

examples.en: The most successful newspaper stories are often declamations of patriotism.
examples.zh: 最成功的报纸报道往往是爱国主义的慷慨陈词。

meanings: 慷慨激昂或夸张修辞的

examples.en: Support for the party continues to decline.
examples.zh: 对该党的支持持续下降。

examples.en: Their spokesman declined to comment on the allegations.
examples.zh: 他们的发言人拒绝就这些指控发表评论。

meanings: 使分离，解除关联或相互依赖

examples.en: Gasoline prices have been decoupled from crude oil prices.
examples.zh: 汽油价格已经与原油价格脱钩。

examples.en: We can deduce a lot from what people choose to buy.
examples.zh: 从人们选择购买的东西中，我们可以推断出很多信息。

meanings: 诽谤，损害名誉的虚假陈述

examples.en: The company sued for defamation.
examples.zh: 这家公司因诽谤提起诉讼。

examples.en: The newspaper denies any intention to defame the senator’s reputation.
examples.zh: 该报否认有意诋毁参议员的名誉。

examples.en: The department deferred the decision for six months.
examples.zh: 该部门把决定推迟了六个月。

examples.en: He was always deferential towards his mentor.
examples.zh: 他对导师一向十分恭敬。

examples.en: The request for a deferral of the inquiry was refused.
examples.zh: 推迟调查的请求被拒绝了。

examples.en: She had suddenly turned into a defiant teenager.
examples.zh: 她突然变成了一个叛逆的少女。

examples.en: The trade balance has been in deficit for the past five years.
examples.zh: 过去五年，贸易收支一直处于赤字状态。

examples.en: Advertising is one of the defining features of our age.
examples.zh: 广告是我们这个时代的典型特征之一。

meanings: 给……下定义（define 的现在分词）

examples.en: Can you give me a definite answer by tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你能在明天之前给我一个明确的答复吗？

examples.en: I wouldn't have dared to defy my teachers.
examples.zh: 我以前可不敢违抗老师。

examples.en: The beauty of the scene defies description.
examples.zh: 此景之美难以用言语描述。

examples.en: The movie is full of scenes of crime and degeneracy.
examples.zh: 这部电影充斥着犯罪和堕落的场景。

examples.en: Her health degenerated quickly.
examples.zh: 她的健康状况迅速恶化。

examples.en: This poster is offensive and degrades women.
examples.zh: 这张海报具有冒犯性，贬低了女性。

examples.en: The bacteria will degrade hydrocarbons.
examples.zh: 这些细菌会分解烃类。

examples.en: She looked so dejected when she lost the game.
examples.zh: 她输了比赛后显得十分沮丧。

examples.en: They decided not to send a delegate to the conference.
examples.zh: 他们决定不派代表参加会议。

meanings: 把职责或权限交给他人
故意的，深思熟虑的，从容不迫的

examples.en: She spoke in a slow and deliberate way.
examples.zh: 她说话缓慢而从容。

examples.en: Babies have very delicate skin.
examples.zh: 婴儿的皮肤非常娇嫩。

examples.en: I admired your delicate handling of the situation.
examples.zh: 我很钦佩你对局面的细致处理。

meanings: 易损的精细物品（常复数）

examples.en: Our objectives need to be precisely delineated.
examples.zh: 我们的目标需要得到准确阐明。

meanings: 违法或不良行为（尤指青少年）

examples.en: She delved in her handbag for a pen.
examples.zh: 她在手提包里翻找一支笔。

examples.en: It was hard to draw clear lines of demarcation between work and leisure.
examples.zh: 很难在工作和休闲之间划出明确的界限。

examples.en: He praised the union's aims but predicted its early demise.
examples.zh: 他赞扬了工会的目标，却预言它会早早垮台。

meanings: 按年龄、收入等划分的人群

examples.en: The products are designed to appeal to a young demographic.
examples.zh: 这些产品旨在吸引年轻人群。

examples.en: He was demonized by sections of the press.
examples.zh: 部分媒体把他妖魔化了。

examples.en: Some people are more demonstrative than others.
examples.zh: 有些人比其他人更容易表露感情。

examples.en: ‘This’ and ‘that’ are demonstrative pronouns.
examples.zh: “This”和“that”是指示代词。

examples.en: At first she demurred, but then finally agreed.
examples.zh: 起初她提出异议，但最终还是同意了。

examples.en: I didn't intend to denigrate her achievements.
examples.zh: 我并无意贬低她的成就。

examples.en: The denizens of the canteen were mainly the accountants and IT staff.
examples.zh: 食堂的常客主要是会计和信息技术人员。

examples.en: The red triangle denotes danger.
examples.zh: 红色三角形表示危险。

examples.en: Here ‘family’ denotes mother, father and children.
examples.zh: 这里的“家庭”指母亲、父亲和孩子。

examples.en: She publicly denounced the government's handling of the crisis.
examples.zh: 她公开谴责政府处理危机的方式。

examples.en: Many people denounced their neighbours to the secret police.
examples.zh: 许多人向秘密警察告发自己的邻居。

examples.en: The population density in this city is very high.
examples.zh: 这座城市的人口密度很高。

examples.en: The bishop made an angry denunciation of the government's policies.
examples.zh: 主教愤怒地谴责了政府的政策。

examples.en: The novel depicts French society in the 1930s.
examples.zh: 这部小说描绘了20世纪30年代的法国社会。

examples.en: Food supplies were severely depleted.
examples.zh: 食物供应严重减少。

examples.en: Tanks were deployed effectively during the long campaign.
examples.zh: 坦克在漫长的战役中得到了有效部署。

examples.en: In my view this book would deprave young children.
examples.zh: 在我看来，这本书会使幼童道德败坏。

meanings: 令人沮丧的，令人消沉的

examples.en: Looking for a job these days can be very depressing.
examples.zh: 如今找工作可能令人十分沮丧。

examples.en: He seemed to be on the verge of total derangement.
examples.zh: 他似乎濒临完全精神失常。

meanings: 解除或放松对行业等的管制

examples.en: The canal has been derelict for many years.
examples.zh: 这条运河已经荒废了很多年。

examples.en: They have been grossly derelict in their duty.
examples.zh: 他们严重玩忽职守。

examples.en: Her speech was greeted with howls of derision.
examples.zh: 她的演讲招来了一片嘲笑声。

examples.en: Who has she designated (as) her deputy?
examples.zh: 她指定了谁担任副手？

examples.en: The different types are designated by the letters A, B and C.
examples.zh: 不同类型用字母A、B和C标示。

examples.en: The war demonstrated the destructive power of modern weapons.
examples.zh: 战争展现了现代武器的破坏力。

examples.en: I wandered about in a desultory fashion.
examples.zh: 我漫无目的地四处闲逛。

examples.en: The skis should detach from the boot if you fall.
examples.zh: 如果跌倒，滑雪板应该能从靴子上脱开。

examples.en: Five destroyers were detached to carry out a bombardment of the port.
examples.zh: 五艘驱逐舰被派去炮轰港口。

examples.en: She tries to remain emotionally detached from her patients.
examples.zh: 她努力在感情上与病人保持距离。

examples.en: The judges show impartiality and detachment.
examples.zh: 法官们表现出公正和超然。

examples.en: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.
examples.zh: 这些检测旨在及早检出这种疾病。

examples.en: The high price of the service could deter people from seeking advice.
examples.zh: 这项服务的高昂价格可能使人们打消寻求建议的念头。

examples.en: Her health deteriorated rapidly, and she died shortly afterwards.
examples.zh: 她的健康迅速恶化，不久后就去世了。

meanings: 减损，降低价值或吸引力

examples.en: The policy will be detrimental to the peace process.
examples.zh: 这项政策将不利于和平进程。

meanings: 有害或不受欢迎的人或事物

examples.en: The kitchen table was still stacked with the detritus of the previous night.
examples.zh: 厨房桌上仍堆着前一晚留下的废弃物。

examples.en: The bomb devastated much of the old part of the city.
examples.zh: 炸弹摧毁了这座城市老城区的大部分地方。

examples.en: He never deviated from his original plan.
examples.zh: 他从未偏离最初的计划。

examples.en: Now connect the device to your computer.
examples.zh: 现在把设备连接到电脑。

examples.en: Metaphor and symbol are literary devices.
examples.zh: 隐喻和象征是文学手法。

examples.en: The letter was devoid of warmth and feeling.
examples.zh: 这封信毫无温暖与感情。

examples.en: We hold diametrically opposed views.
examples.zh: 我们的观点截然相反。

examples.en: He launched a bitter diatribe against the younger generation.
examples.zh: 他对年轻一代展开了长篇尖刻的抨击。

meanings: 分为对立或相异两部分的

examples.en: The generals established a military dictatorship.
examples.zh: 将军们建立了军事独裁统治。

examples.en: The didactic teacher-led approach is no longer fashionable.
examples.zh: 由教师主导的传授式教学方法已不再流行。

meanings: 营养师（dietician 的复数，亦作 dietitians）

examples.en: She overcame her natural diffidence and spoke with great frankness.
examples.zh: 她克服了天生的羞怯，十分坦率地开口说话。

examples.en: To digress for a moment, I would like to remind you that there will be no classes next week.
examples.zh: 容我暂时离题一下，我想提醒大家下周不上课。

examples.en: The government has been dilatory in dealing with the problem of unemployment.
examples.zh: 政府在处理失业问题上一直拖拖拉拉。

examples.en: This light is too dim to read by.
examples.zh: 这盏灯太暗，没法看书。

examples.en: She had a dim recollection of the visit.
examples.zh: 她对那次拜访只有模糊的记忆。

examples.en: Her future career prospects look dim.
examples.zh: 她未来的职业前景看起来很暗淡。

examples.en: The world's resources are rapidly diminishing.
examples.zh: 世界的资源正在迅速减少。

examples.en: I don't wish to diminish the importance of their contribution.
examples.zh: 我无意贬低他们贡献的重要性。

examples.en: The peace talks broke up in disarray.
examples.zh: 和平谈判在混乱中破裂。

examples.en: The committee formally disbanded in August.
examples.zh: 该委员会于八月正式解散。

examples.en: He had discarded his jacket because of the heat.
examples.zh: 因为天气炎热，他脱掉了外套。

examples.en: We could just discern the house in the distance.
examples.zh: 我们只能隐约辨认出远处的房子。

examples.en: I quickly discerned that something was wrong.
examples.zh: 我很快觉察到有些不对劲。

examples.en: His face was barely discernible in the gloom.
examples.zh: 他的脸在昏暗中几乎辨认不出来。

examples.en: The wound started discharging pus.
examples.zh: 伤口开始流脓。

examples.en: Patients were being discharged from the hospital too early.
examples.zh: 病人出院得太早了。

examples.en: I cannot disclose what we discussed.
examples.zh: 我不能透露我们讨论了什么。

meanings: 使不安、窘迫或失去镇定

examples.en: His answer rather disconcerted her.
examples.zh: 他的答复使她颇为不安。

examples.en: This new evidence discredits earlier findings.
examples.zh: 这项新证据使早先的发现失去了可信度。

examples.en: The photos were deliberately taken to discredit the president.
examples.zh: 拍这些照片是为了故意败坏总统的名誉。

meanings: 自行判断或决定的权力

examples.en: Use the utmost discretion when you talk to her.
examples.zh: 和她交谈时务必十分谨慎。

examples.en: Bail is granted at the discretion of the court.
examples.zh: 是否准予保释由法院自行裁量。

examples.en: The meetings were informal, discursive, even gossipy.
examples.zh: 会议不拘形式，话题散漫，甚至带些闲聊性质。

examples.en: She treated him with disdain.
examples.zh: 她轻蔑地对待他。

examples.en: She's always been disdainful of people who haven't been to college.
examples.zh: 她一向瞧不起没上过大学的人。

examples.en: They wished to disengage themselves from these policies.
examples.zh: 他们希望与这些政策脱离关系。

examples.en: The pipe disgorges sewage into the sea.
examples.zh: 这根管道把污水排入大海。

meanings: 使人失去希望或勇气的

examples.en: It would be disingenuous of me to claim I had never seen it.
examples.zh: 若我声称从未见过它，就不诚实了。

examples.en: Her casual dismissal of the threats seemed irresponsible.
examples.zh: 她对这些威胁轻率地不予理会，显得不负责任。

examples.en: The high level of disorganization at the hospital is inexcusable.
examples.zh: 这家医院高度混乱的状况不可原谅。

examples.en: The darkness had disoriented him.
examples.zh: 黑暗使他迷失了方向。

examples.en: Ex-soldiers can be disoriented by the transition to civilian life.
examples.zh: 退役军人在转向平民生活时可能会感到无所适从。

examples.en: Her family disowned her for marrying him.
examples.zh: 她的家人因她嫁给他而与她断绝关系。

examples.en: I don't mean to disparage your achievements.
examples.zh: 我无意贬低你的成就。

meanings: 由不同性质的成分组成的

examples.en: Troops have been dispatched to the area.
examples.zh: 部队已被派往该地区。

examples.en: His speech dispelled any fears about his health.
examples.zh: 他的讲话消除了人们对他健康状况的担忧。

examples.en: The machine dispenses a range of drinks and snacks.
examples.zh: 这台机器售卖各种饮料和零食。

examples.en: The organization dispenses free healthcare to those who need it.
examples.zh: 该组织向有需要的人提供免费医疗服务。

examples.en: The seeds are dispersed by the wind.
examples.zh: 种子由风传播。

examples.en: The fog began to disperse.
examples.zh: 雾开始消散了。

meanings: 与相对规模或程度不相称的

examples.en: The area contains a disproportionate number of young middle-class families.
examples.zh: 这个地区的年轻中产阶级家庭数量多得不成比例。

examples.en: The theory has now been disproved.
examples.zh: 这个理论现在已经被证明是错误的。

examples.en: The union is in dispute with management over working hours.
examples.zh: 工会正在就工作时间与管理层发生争执。

examples.en: There is considerable public disquiet about the safety of the new trains.
examples.zh: 公众对新列车的安全性深感不安。

meanings: 正式、详尽的专题论述或探讨

examples.en: She was a very honest person who was incapable of dissembling.
examples.zh: 她是个非常诚实的人，根本不会掩饰作假。

examples.en: The two languages are completely dissimilar from each other.
examples.zh: 这两种语言彼此完全不同。

examples.en: Eventually, his anger dissipated.
examples.zh: 他的怒气最终消散了。

examples.en: She was determined to achieve results and not to dissipate her energies.
examples.zh: 她决心取得成果，不浪费精力。

examples.en: He tied a piece of cloth around his upper arm to impede circulation and distend the veins.
examples.zh: 他在上臂绑了一块布，以阻碍血液循环，使静脉鼓起。

examples.en: She sensed his deep emotional distress.
examples.zh: 她察觉到了他内心深深的痛苦。

examples.en: It is a rule of the sea to help another boat in distress.
examples.zh: 帮助另一艘遇险的船是海上的规则。

meanings: 令人痛苦、忧虑或不安的

examples.en: It was a very distressing documentary.
examples.zh: 那是一部令人十分痛苦的纪录片。

examples.en: The car left the road and ended up in a ditch.
examples.zh: 汽车驶离了道路，最后落进沟里。

examples.en: There are divergent opinions on this issue.
examples.zh: 在这个问题上，意见各不相同。

examples.en: After her illness she was divested of much of her responsibility.
examples.zh: 她生病后，大部分职责都被免去了。

examples.en: The company is divesting itself of some of its assets.
examples.zh: 这家公司正在出售部分资产。

examples.en: The government is divided on this issue.
examples.zh: 政府在这个问题上存在分歧。

meanings: 造成分裂或意见对立的

examples.en: He believes that unemployment is socially divisive.
examples.zh: 他认为失业会造成社会分裂。

examples.en: My parents are divorced.
examples.zh: 我的父母离婚了。

examples.en: He seems completely divorced from reality.
examples.zh: 他似乎完全脱离了现实。

meanings: 泄露，透露（秘密或原本不为人知的信息）

examples.en: She refused to divulge the information.
examples.zh: 她拒绝透露这些信息。

meanings: 不顾实际而死守教条的

examples.en: He challenged the Christian doctrine of Original Sin.
examples.zh: 他对基督教的原罪教义提出了质疑。

examples.en: He ran across the road, dodging the traffic.
examples.zh: 他躲闪着车流跑过马路。

examples.en: He dodged his military service.
examples.zh: 他逃避了兵役。

examples.en: He was strident and dogmatic in giving his opinions.
examples.zh: 他发表意见时咄咄逼人、十分武断。

examples.en: I've had my doubts about his work since he joined the firm.
examples.zh: 自从他加入公司，我就对他的工作抱有疑虑。

examples.en: The horses are doused with buckets of cold water.
examples.zh: 人们用一桶桶冷水浇湿马匹。

examples.en: He doused the flames with a fire extinguisher.
examples.zh: 他用灭火器扑灭了火焰。

examples.en: The overall mood of the meeting was downbeat.
examples.zh: 会议的整体气氛很消沉。

examples.en: The coach is downplaying the team's poor performance.
examples.zh: 教练正在淡化球队表现不佳的问题。

examples.en: It's not just stupid—it's downright dangerous.
examples.zh: 这不仅愚蠢——简直危险。

examples.en: The worsening situation forced the company to downsize from 39 employees to 7.
examples.zh: 不断恶化的情况迫使公司将员工从39人裁减到7人。

examples.en: The couple are downsizing to a more compact home.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇正搬到更小的住宅。

examples.en: Output has been drastically reduced.
examples.zh: 产量被大幅削减了。

examples.en: There was a droll, cynical expression on his face.
examples.zh: 他的脸上带着一种滑稽而讥诮的表情。

meanings: 有延展性的，可拉成丝的

examples.en: Life in a small town could be deadly dull.
examples.zh: 小镇上的生活可能极其乏味。

examples.en: The original experiment cannot be exactly duplicated.
examples.zh: 原来的实验无法完全复制。

examples.en: The leaked documents reveal the duplicitous nature of government propaganda.
examples.zh: 泄露的文件揭露了政府宣传的欺骗本质。

examples.en: Painted steel is likely to be less durable than other kinds.
examples.zh: 涂漆的钢材可能不如其他种类的材料耐用。

meanings: 使相形见绌，使显得矮小

examples.en: Membership of the club has dwindled from 70 to 20.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的会员人数已从70人逐渐减少到20人。

meanings: 逐渐减少（dwindle 的现在分词）

examples.en: Despite her earnest efforts, she could not find a job.
examples.zh: 尽管她认真努力，还是没能找到工作。

examples.en: He gazed earnestly into my eyes.
examples.zh: 他诚恳地凝视着我的眼睛。

examples.en: He didn't have an earthly chance of getting the job.
examples.zh: 他根本不可能得到那份工作。

examples.en: Morale among teachers is at a low ebb.
examples.zh: 教师们的士气处于低谷。

meanings: 热情洋溢的，兴高采烈的

examples.en: The prime minister was in ebullient mood.
examples.zh: 首相兴高采烈。

examples.en: We all have our little eccentricities.
examples.zh: 我们都有自己小小的怪癖。

examples.en: An ecstasy of bliss poured through me.
examples.zh: 一阵极度的喜悦涌遍我全身。

meanings: 促进基督教各教派团结的

examples.en: The food at the hotel was barely edible.
examples.zh: 酒店的食物几乎难以下咽。

examples.en: No doubt Hamish will edify us on the subject.
examples.zh: 哈米什无疑会就这个问题给我们一些指教。

examples.en: Some debates in Parliament are shown live and are outside editorial control.
examples.zh: 议会中的某些辩论进行现场直播，不受编辑控制。

examples.en: They despised us as effete art students.
examples.zh: 他们鄙视我们，认为我们是娇弱无力的艺术生。

examples.en: They hope the new drug will prove especially efficacious in the relief of pain.
examples.zh: 他们希望这种新药在缓解疼痛方面特别有效。

meanings: 散发出的气体或排出物

examples.en: He was effusive in his praise.
examples.zh: 他毫不掩饰地热烈赞扬。

meanings: 主张平等的，平等主义的

examples.en: He described himself as ‘an egalitarian’.
examples.zh: 他把自己称为“平等主义者”。

examples.en: I had prepared a very elaborate meal.
examples.zh: 我准备了一顿精心制作的饭菜。

examples.en: Her poetry has an elegiac quality.
examples.zh: 她的诗歌带有挽歌般的特质。

meanings: 哀悼或沉思怀旧的诗、乐曲

examples.en: I could elicit no response from him.
examples.zh: 我没能从他那里引出任何回应。

examples.en: The acid causes the cells to elongate by increasing the uptake of water.
examples.zh: 这种酸通过增加细胞的吸水量使细胞伸长。

meanings: 雄辩的，表达流畅有力的

examples.en: His eyes were eloquent.
examples.zh: 他的眼神很传神。

examples.en: Their objectives and methods require further elucidation.
examples.zh: 他们的目标和方法需要进一步阐明。

examples.en: The two men managed to elude the police for six weeks.
examples.zh: 那两个人设法躲避了警方六个星期。

examples.en: He was extremely tired, but sleep eluded him.
examples.zh: 他极度疲惫，却无法入睡。

examples.en: Eric, as elusive as ever, was nowhere to be found.
examples.zh: 埃里克像往常一样行踪不定，哪儿也找不到。

examples.en: They felt they had at last been emancipated from their father’s control.
examples.zh: 他们觉得自己终于摆脱了父亲的控制。

meanings: 使成为不可分的一部分

examples.en: The bullet embedded itself in the wall.
examples.zh: 子弹嵌进了墙里。

meanings: 给叙述增添夸张或虚构细节

examples.en: The huge carved door was embellished with brass door knockers.
examples.zh: 巨大的雕花门上装饰着黄铜门环。

examples.en: His account of his travels was embellished with details of famous people he met.
examples.zh: 他讲述旅行经历时，添油加醋地加入了遇见名人的细节。

examples.en: The dove is an emblem of peace.
examples.zh: 鸽子是和平的象征。

examples.en: The violence is emblematic of what is happening in our inner cities.
examples.zh: 这种暴力典型地体现了我们市中心地区正在发生的事情。

examples.en: This model embodies many new features.
examples.zh: 这个型号包含许多新功能。

examples.en: Emboldened by her friendly smile, he went over to talk to her.
examples.zh: 她友好的微笑给了他勇气，他便走过去和她交谈。

meanings: 萌芽阶段的，尚未成熟的

examples.en: The project is still fairly embryonic.
examples.zh: 这个项目仍处于相当初步的阶段。

examples.en: Few could have predicted that she would reach eminence as a surgeon.
examples.zh: 很少有人预料到她会成为杰出的外科医生。

examples.en: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
examples.zh: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒声。

examples.en: Sulphur gases were emitted by the volcano.
examples.zh: 火山排放出了含硫气体。

meanings: 皇帝，帝国的最高男性君主

examples.en: He was emphatic that he could not work with her.
examples.zh: 他坚决表示自己不能和她共事。

meanings: 基于观察、经验或实验的
依靠观察和实验的方法

examples.en: The courts were empowered to impose the death sentence for certain crimes.
examples.zh: 法院被授权对某些罪行判处死刑。

examples.en: She hopes to emulate her sister's sporting achievements.
examples.zh: 她希望赶上姐姐在体育方面的成就。

examples.en: The poem encapsulates many of the central themes of her writing.
examples.zh: 这首诗浓缩了她写作中的许多核心主题。

examples.en: The group encompasses all ages.
examples.zh: 这个群体涵盖了所有年龄段。

examples.en: The fog soon encompassed the whole valley.
examples.zh: 雾很快笼罩了整个山谷。

examples.en: He never allows work to encroach upon his family life.
examples.zh: 他从不让工作侵占家庭生活。

examples.en: The police operation was encumbered by crowds of reporters.
examples.zh: 大批记者妨碍了警方的行动。

examples.en: She has an encyclopedic knowledge of natural history.
examples.zh: 她的自然史知识非常广博。

meanings: 在某地区或群体持续存在的

examples.en: Malaria is endemic in many hot countries.
examples.zh: 疟疾在许多炎热国家持续流行。

examples.en: I wholeheartedly endorse his remarks.
examples.zh: 我全心全意支持他的言论。

examples.en: I wonder how many celebrities actually use the products they endorse.
examples.zh: 我想知道有多少名人真的使用他们所代言的产品。
